_comment: Resonance powers. school: mercy | dominion | universal (alignment changes cost). target: self | ally | party | enemy | area_enemy (radius around target) | self_area (radius around caster). Cost modifiers (applied in order): medium armor +2, heavy armor blocks, alignment tier +-1/2, Tide form -1, prestige; minimum 1.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Knit flesh or metal with Resonance: heals 2d6 + level + WIS mod. Works on organics and machines.

restore.name: Restore
restore.desc: Heals 3d6 + level + WIS mod and purges damage-over-time effects.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.desc: A Resonance barrier: +2 Defense and absorbs 10 kinetic/energy/thermal damage for 5 rounds.

aegis_greater.name: Greater Aegis
aegis_greater.desc: Shields the whole party: +3 Defense and absorbs 15 damage each for 5 rounds.

shove.name: Shove
shove.desc: Telekinetic shove: 1d6 kinetic, pushes the target 3 m back and knocks it down for 1 round unless it passes a Reflex save.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc: Every enemy within 4 m takes 2d6 kinetic, is pushed back and knocked down on a failed Reflex save.

surge.name: Surge
surge.desc: Resonance-driven movement: +50% speed and +1 Defense for 5 rounds.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.desc: +100% speed, +2 Defense and +1 attack for 5 rounds.

arc_lance.name: Arc Lance
arc_lance.desc: A lance of raw Resonance: 2d6 + level resonance damage (Reflex for half).

arc_storm.name: Arc Storm
arc_storm.desc: Arcs jump between up to 3 enemies within 5 m: 3d6 + level each (Reflex for half).

hold.name: Hold
hold.desc: Lock a mind in place: Will save or the target is Held (cannot act or move) for 2 rounds. Machines are immune.

stasis_field.name: Stasis Field
stasis_field.desc: Hold every enemy within 3 m of the target (Will negates).

dread.name: Dread
dread.desc: Flood a mind with dread: Will save or the target flees for 3 rounds. Taking damage ends the fear. Machines are immune.

calm.name: Calm
calm.desc: Quiet the urge to fight: Will save or the target will not attack for 3 rounds. Taking damage ends it.

disrupt.name: Disrupt
disrupt.desc: Overload circuitry: 2d6 ion damage (doubled against machines); a machine that fails a Fortitude save is stunned for 1 round.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.desc: Drain life: 1d8 + level resonance damage (Fortitude for half); you heal the amount dealt. Organic targets only.

echo_sense.name: Echo Sense
echo_sense.desc: Listen to the ship's residual memory: +4 Awareness for 10 rounds and immediately reveals hidden mines, hazards and people within 15 m.

sway.name: Sway
sway.desc: Lean on a mind with Resonance. In conversation it unlocks Resonance-assisted persuasion. In combat: Will save or the target is Wavering (-2 attack, -2 Will) for 2 rounds.

compel.name: Compel
compel.desc: Override a will outright. In conversation it unlocks coercion. In combat: Will save or the target stops attacking for 2 rounds, even if hurt. Machines are immune.

repair_beam.name: Repair Beam
repair_beam.desc: Machine ability: patches an allied machine for 2d6 + level.

suppression_field.name: Suppression Field
suppression_field.desc: Machine ability: a gravitic snare. Targets within 2.5 m that fail a Reflex save (DC 13) are immobilized for 2 rounds.

suppression_pulse.name: Suppression Pulse
suppression_pulse.desc: Machine ability: a concussive discharge. Enemies within 4 m that fail a Fortitude save (DC 14) are stunned for 1 round.
